name: @johnhenry/math-plus-tensor-wasm
description: Rust→WASM CPU kernels for Math Plus tensors — flat-numeric extern-C ABI, no wasm-bindgen marshalling on hot paths

scripts.build:wasm:scalar: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p tensor-wasm-kernels && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs tensor_wasm_kernels.wasm
scripts.build:wasm:simd: RUSTFLAGS="-C link-args=--import-memory" cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p tensor-wasm-kernels --features simd && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs tensor_wasm_kernels_simd128.wasm
scripts.build:wasm: npm run build:wasm:scalar && npm run build:wasm:simd
scripts._comment:test:bench: Deliberately NOT chained into `test`: these assert wall-clock speedups, and GitHub's runner fleet is mixed -- one runner measured 1.12x SIMD gain, another 1.01x (no gain, zero variance) on the same commit. A threshold low enough to pass the slowest runner would also pass a real regression to parity, so the assertion is only meaningful on known hardware. Run it locally, or on a self-hosted runner, before trusting a perf claim.
